verdict.rationale: Zoho Invoice does ship automations, such as payment reminders, recurring invoices, scheduled sending and quote-to-invoice conversion, so this axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence describes versioning, review history, diffing or rollback of those automation configurations. Being able to create automations is a different capability from managing their versions, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
